Team,

As we prep materials for the Dec QBR I want a concise, single-source summary of launch readiness for the product areas we own. Please do the following by EOD Tue Dec 8: 

- Update the shared sheet (link below) with 1) current status (on-track / at-risk / blocked), 2) top 2 delivery risks, 3) mitigation plan + owner, 4) ETA for resolution. Keep entries to one-line bullets per field.
- Attach any short artifacts (logs, docus, short runbooks) as stubs.

I'm attaching the launch_risk_sheet.csv template and the QBR slide template. Use the sheet to populate the QBR slide (we'll combine into the executive pack).

Primary ask for this thread: call out any cross-team blockers that require exec attention. I'll consolidate on Dec 7 and circulate the QBR-ready slide deck on Dec 8 morning.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-prep-redwood-launch
Attachments: [Attachment: launch_risk_sheet.csv (csv)], [Attachment: QBR_slide_template.pptx (pptx)]

Thanks — keep updates terse.

-Stephanie Nguyen

Steph — quick status from runtime/infra side: 

- Status: at-risk (partial) for 2.1 runtime rollout
- Top risks:
  1) Kernel-level regression seen in perf test job KRN-78: tail latency spike at p95 when sequence length > 1,024. Root cause likely new attention kernel in recent build.
  2) Driver incompatibility on our Dedicated pool (NVIDIA driver 535.x) causing OOM on long-context workloads during batch replay.
- Mitigations:
  1) Roll back to previous attention kernel for canary (owner: k.iyer). Run perf baseline by Dec 4. JIRA: JIRA-SUP-1234.
  2) Coordinate with CloudOps vendor to pin driver at 534.* on Dedicated nodes; fallback plan: auto-route long-context to hosted variant for 48h (owner: markus.klein).
- ETA: canary rollback and perf verification by EOD Dec 4; full rollout contingent on perf signoff (target Dec 9).

Note: I added a short log excerpt to the Drive sheet.

Adding product perspective and a small customer-facing risk: 

- Status: at-risk for feature set v1.3 (analytics hooks and A/B toggles)
- Top risks:
  1) Third-party analytics SDK (vendor update) broke our telemetry ingestion for the behavioral events pipeline. Impact: inability to measure launch metrics for first 48h.
  2) Feature freeze ambiguity — some teams are still pushing late opt-in changes which increases regression risk.
- Mitigations:
  1) Roll back SDK to previous stable version and gate telemetry ingestion; owner: marissa.cole. Emily Stone at Acme asked about the analytics SLA — cc'd procurement if we need to expedite contractual remedies.
  2) Strict freeze: any changes need a signoff from both product and eng (owner: laura.bennett).
- ETA: SDK rollback by Dec 5; freeze enforcement immediate.

Attachments referenced: small test report (added as note in Drive).

Short infra note: 

- Status: at-risk (capacity/config overlap)
- Top risks:
  1) Dedicated GPU pool autoscale policy not tested under mixed long/short contexts; risk of noisy neighbor on shared nodes.
  2) Scheduled CloudOps maintenance window (Dec 6 02:00–06:00 UTC) overlaps canary rollout (Karthik's target).
- Mitigations:
  1) Configure strict node-pinning for canary; reserve 2 nodes as isolated canary pool (owner: markus.klein).
  2) Asked CloudOps to postpone maintenance by 24h; if not approved, will shift canary to Dec 7 and extend fallback routing to hosted variant for 36h.
- ETA: node pinning by Dec 5; decision on maintenance by Dec 5 COB.

Thanks for the quick updates — consolidated actions below (please treat as assigned deliverables):

1) Karthik: deploy kernel rollback to canary, run perf baseline, post p95/p99 numbers to Drive by EOD Dec 4 (if delayed, escalate to me).
2) Markus: finalize node pinning and secure postponement of maintenance; confirm by Dec 5 COB. If CloudOps cannot postpone, move canary to Dec 7 and update fallback routing.
3) Marissa: complete SDK rollback and note impact to customer metrics; update customer-facing messaging draft (cc'd Emily).
4) Laura & Tessa: prepare QBR slide that clearly states the ask thresholds (hold/full rollout criteria + emergency capacity ask). Slide to be uploaded to Drive by Dec 8 12:00 PT.

I'll collect the final QBR deck on Dec 8 morning, run a brief dry run on Dec 9 and push the exec pack after signoff. If any of the owners cannot meet the ETA, flag immediately so we can adjust the canary window.
